blocks.text: LIMAY, Bataan — Members of youth group Young Bataeños for Environmental Advocacy Network (YoungBean) and advocacy group Nuclear-Free Bataan Movement (NFBM) lit candles in Limay town to mourn the trees cut down along Roman Highway and other parts of Bataan. In a statement on Sunday, Eric Beren, YoungBean secretary general, said the activity was part of the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. “While we remember our departed loved ones, we also mourn the trees that have been cut along our roads in Bataan,” Beren said.
